floater.name: prism_welcome
floater.title: WELCOME TO PRISM
floater.text: A few choices to make yourself at home.

panel.name: graphics_card

check_box.name: update_graphics
check_box.label: Use the latest Prism graphics defaults
check_box.tool_tip: Updates SSS, PCSS, GTAO, SSGI, TAA, Post, Bloom, Eye Adaptation, Water, Clouds, Ground Fog and Volumetric Fog, including effect tuning, colours and SSS detection lists.

panel.text: Apply Prism's latest lighting, shadows, water, clouds and post-processing defaults. This replaces your effect tuning, colours and SSS detection lists.

Your graphics are ready.
Your current graphics preferences will be kept. You can adjust effects any time in Preferences > Graphics.

panel.name: movement_card

check_box.name: try_movement
check_box.label: Try the new camera & movement experience
check_box.tool_tip: Enables world-drag turning, backward-facing walking, camera-relative movement with independent orbit, dynamic shoulder camera, and prevention of mouselook when zooming in. Camera-relative movement takes priority over backward-facing walking and drag turning.

panel.text: Move in the direction you're looking, orbit freely, and ease into an over-the-shoulder view as you zoom in. Stay in third person even at the closest zoom.
Optional. Each part can be adjusted or turned off later.

floater.text: Find these controls in Preferences > Move & View > Prism Options, under Camera & Movement Experience.
